metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 GEDCOM/GEDZIP CLI in:

- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp)

It builds successfully with:

```bash
cd output
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```

The `gedcom_tool` executable supports `inspect`, `render`, `inspect_gedzip`, and `render_gedzip`, with structured JSON errors and standard-library ZIP/DEFLATE handling.
